description: Use this when the user wants to begin tracking time on a specific project. The user can optionally specify a custom start time in the past, otherwise it defaults to now.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the project to track time for. Use project_list to find available projects.

startDateTime.description: Optional start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-08T10:30:00Z"). If not provided, uses current time.

name: timer_start

duration.description: Duration of the running task in seconds

pause.description: The current break, while the timer is paused

task.description: The running task, with its project. Absent when no timer runs.

title: Start Timer
